Package com.splendor.view

Class NetworkGameView

java.lang.Object
com.splendor.view.NetworkGameView
All Implemented Interfaces:
IGameView
public class NetworkGameView extends Object implements IGameView
Implements IGameView for a network game with one RemoteView per player. Turn-based prompts are routed to the active player's client. Broadcast calls (display, notifications) are sent to every client.

    • displayAvailableMoves

      public void displayAvailableMoves(List<MenuOption> options, Game game)
      For CPU players, broadcasts the board and menu to every client so they can observe the bot's available options. For human players this is a no-op because their RemoteView already sends the board inside promptForMove, avoiding a double render.
      Specified by:
      displayAvailableMoves in interface IGameView
      Parameters:
      options - The menu options to display
      game - Current game state
